visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown and pink highlights in her hair, wearing a yellow short-sleeved top and a floral knit headband, crawls under a wooden table in a brightly lit indoor room. She looks directly into the camera with a searching expression. (2) The scene cuts to her head appearing inside a yellow pop-up tent, looking around. (3) The scene shifts to an office setting where she peers over the shoulder of a person sitting at a desk with a white keyboard and black mouse. (4) The woman is sitting on a gray sofa holding a silver laptop, looking at the camera and gesturing with her hands. (5) A series of close-up screen captures follow, showing an iPhone screen navigating the 'Find My' app, then a MacBook Air screen showing the same app with map locations, and finally a desktop monitor where 'icloud.com/find' is typed into a browser and an Apple ID login screen appears. (6) The woman stands outside on a sunny street, holding her laptop and looking surprised, then turns to watch a large yellow garbage truck drive past her on a multi-lane road.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly over a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady kick drum beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the voice continues with an instructional tone, coinciding with the first tip. (3) Digital 'click' and 'ding' sounds are heard interspersed with the narration as she describes UI interactions. (4) The BGM remains continuous and driving throughout the tutorial phases. (5) As the woman expresses confusion ('Huh?'), the music briefly ducks, followed by a comedic 'stunned' sound effect and the distinct low-frequency hum of a heavy vehicle engine and the rattling sound of a garbage truck.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Tutorial (3 Methods) -> Surprise/Humorous Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate users on the different methods of locating a lost iPhone (using the app on iOS/Mac or via web browser) while maintaining engagement through a relatable comedic skit.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features Apple products (iPhone, MacBook Air) and specifically demonstrates Apple's 'Find My' ecosystem and iCloud services.
